description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Base Creative Office is the in-house creative team behind everything the Base brand ships, from brand campaigns and the Powered by Base video series to Base Batches content, live events, and builder programs. As a Senior Producer, you'll own production end to end for this full portfolio, turning incoming briefs into scoped, staffed, on-time deliveries. You'll partner directly with Base Marketing, Comms, and leadership as the single point of accountability the team trusts to get it done.

What you'll do:
  • Own end-to-end production for Base Creative Office's full portfolio, including brand campaigns, video series, case studies, social assets, and live event builds (booths, signage, merch, AV).
  • Triage incoming creative requests, scope each into a clear brief with timeline and staffing plan, and push back plainly when a deadline doesn't match production reality.
  • Balance the Creative Office team's day-to-day workload across concurrent projects so nothing gets dropped and nobody gets overloaded.
  • Source and manage external vendors, printers, AV partners, and contractors when a project needs outside help, including on-the-ground event production.
  • Run the review and approval process across brand, legal, and executive stakeholders, consolidating feedback into one clear round of revisions and shipping final assets with organized handoffs.
  • Build lightweight tools, workflows, and AI-assisted processes that let a small team keep pace with high-volume requests while maintaining a human final check on every deliverable.


Required Skills and Experience:
  • 7+ years producing brand, video, or live-event/experiential content, including running full production cycles from brief through delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Proven ability to manage simultaneous productions independently, each with its own timeline, budget, and stakeholders, and to set realistic schedules and escalate when timelines are not feasible.
  • Hands-on experience producing physical and event elements (booth builds, signage, merch, AV) and managing the vendors behind them, not just video or digital assets.
  • Track record running stakeholder review processes across marketing, brand, legal, and executive reviewers, with demonstrated ability to consolidate feedback and drive decisions.
  • Experience working inside an in-house creative or brand team with shared resources, direct accountability to a creative lead, and ownership as a single point of contact for production delivery.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 

 

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):
$170,765—$200,900 USD
